kpis.signal: Recovery post-creux FY23, segment edge/AI computing porte 2024-25
kpis.description_fr: CA total Zebra Technologies. Creux FY23 lie destockage clients enterprise post-2022. Recovery 2024-25 portee par renouvellement mobile computing flotte + AI/RFID.
kpis.description_en: Zebra Technologies total revenue. FY23 trough from enterprise customer destocking post-2022. 2024-25 recovery driven by mobile computing fleet refresh + AI/RFID.

kpis.signal: Segment leader Zebra, mobile computing entreprise + logiciel/IA workforce
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Connected Frontline (mobile computing entreprise + services logiciel + AI agents). Issu reorganisation Q1 2025 (ex-EVM). Plus gros segment, croissance solide 2024-25 sur fleet refresh.
kpis.description_en: Connected Frontline segment revenue (enterprise mobile computing + software services + AI agents). Result of Q1 2025 reorg (ex-EVM). Largest segment, solid 2024-25 growth on fleet refresh.

kpis.signal: Segment RFID + barcode + machine vision, expose retail+logistique
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Asset Visibility and Automation (impression barcode/cartes, RFID, RTLS, machine vision, supplies). Issu reorganisation Q1 2025 (ex-AIT + machine vision EVM). Marche supply chain digitalisation.
kpis.description_en: Asset Visibility and Automation segment revenue (barcode/card printing, RFID, RTLS, machine vision, supplies). Result of Q1 2025 reorg (ex-AIT + EVM machine vision). Supply chain digitalization market.

kpis.signal: Recurring revenue stream, mix qualite, ~18% du CA total FY25
kpis.description_fr: CA services et logiciels (maintenance, abonnements logiciels, services managed). Croissance reguliere malgre cycle hardware. ~18% CA total FY25, pilote la transition vers modele recurring software-defined.
kpis.description_en: Services and software revenue (maintenance, software subscriptions, managed services). Steady growth despite hardware cycle. ~18% of FY25 total revenue, drives transition to recurring software-defined model.

kpis.signal: Marge CF ~20% FY25, fort levier post-recovery 2024
kpis.description_fr: Resultat operationnel segment Connected Frontline. Marge ~20% FY25 (vs ~14% FY23 creux). Fort levier operationnel sur recovery volumes mobile computing.
kpis.description_en: Connected Frontline segment operating income. ~20% margin FY25 (vs ~14% in FY23 trough). Strong operating leverage on mobile computing volume recovery.

kpis.name_fr: Resultat operationnel Asset Visibility and Automation
kpis.signal: Marge AVA ~21% FY25, levier mix RFID + supplies recurring
kpis.description_fr: Resultat operationnel segment AVA. Marge ~21% FY25 (+22% YoY). Mix produit favorable RFID + supplies recurring + impression cards specialisee.
kpis.description_en: AVA segment operating income. ~21% margin FY25 (+22% YoY). Favorable mix: RFID + recurring supplies + specialty card printing.

kpis.signal: Marge brute ~48% stable, structure cost efficiente
kpis.description_fr: Marge brute consolidee. ~48% du CA FY25 (vs 48.5% FY24). Mix software/services + supplies en hausse compense pressions sur hardware.
kpis.description_en: Consolidated gross profit. ~48% of FY25 revenue (vs 48.5% FY24). Higher software/services + supplies mix offsets hardware pricing pressure.

kpis_story.description_fr: Acquisitions Matrox Imaging 2022 + Antuit.ai 2021 : vision IA pour quality inspection + AI forecasting retail. Différenciation vs Honeywell.
kpis_story.description_en: Matrox Imaging 2022 + Antuit.ai 2021 acquisitions: AI vision for quality inspection + AI retail forecasting. Differentiation vs Honeywell.

_notes: Industrial mobile computing. Source: 10-K FY24 filed Feb 2025.
